about.description: Single-stock perpetual futures market on QFEX tracking SUI Group Holdings Limited, quoted in USD, cross-margined in USDC and trading 24/7 with up to 10x leverage. QFEX is a hybrid central-limit-order-book exchange for traditional assets only; positions are cash-settled and confer no ownership, dividend or voting rights in the underlying. Reference prices are consumed from primary venues during the instrument's published reference-price hours and funding is zero outside them. SUI Group Holdings Limited was named Mill City Ventures III, Ltd. until 2025-08-26; it is a Minnesota corporation operating as a SUI digital-asset treasury vehicle.
